anti_overlap: Do NOT re-derive detector-vs-detector independence WITHIN a frame, weight-selection, input-resolution, or threshold tuning — the CV cascade-independence lens (fd-cv-cascade-independence) owns per-frame detector independence and the same-weights fact. That the gate aliases vision_face to the same face_yolov8n weights is the CV lens's; that production's weir has no vision_face off-take at all is yours.

Do NOT audit whether A fixture (one static frame) genuinely FIRES the real model, or the statistical validity of the fixture SET — the verification/exercised-semantics lens (fd-verification-exercised-semantics) owns single-frame test-firing. Your concern is the partition it feeds: whether the face-bearing unit, once produced, is ROUTED into an accounted redaction share at the production division-box, and whether the gate measures the same division-box production runs.

Do NOT audit whether a produced box physically COVERS the real face pixels in a frame (letterbox math, dilation, clamp, degenerate) — the urushi lacquer-bond lens (fd-urushi-lacquer-repair-coverage-bond) owns box-to-pixel adhesion within one frame. You take a produced box's pixel coverage as given and reason only about whether the box is ROUTED into an accounted redaction share at the real division-box, or spills past every gauge.

Do NOT trace the ATTESTATION / chain-of-transmission PROVENANCE of the gate's verdict (who witnessed, whether a report reaches an eyewitness, a broken/concealed narrator chain) — the isnad lens (fd-isnad-transmission-chain-authentication) owns chain-of-transmission authentication. Do NOT critique documentation-as-interface integrity or stale governance/out-of-scope TEXT for its own sake — the contracts scope-honesty lens (fd-contracts-scope-honesty) owns static-text integrity. Do NOT reason along the TIME AXIS of the moving sequence (stride-gap stragglers, confirm-hits birth latency, mis-association across frames, coverage holding across consecutive frames) — the transhumance flock-guard lens (fd-transhumance-flock-guard-continuity) owns temporal continuity. Your axis is the SINGLE division event: at the moment of apportionment, is the face-bearing unit routed into an accounted share at the production weir? You take the per-frame instant as given and ask only whether the partition/off-take is correct there, not whether coverage persists over time.

distance_rationale: Communal water-apportionment at a physical division-weir is a pre-modern, non-Western, physical-craft discipline with no shared parent with any covered domain, and its native axis — PARTITION / APPORTIONMENT INTEGRITY at the point where one stream is DIVIDED into accounted share-channels — is owned by NONE of the seven covered lenses. The CV cascade-independence lens reasons about detector-vs-detector independence WITHIN a frame (weights, thresholds, resolution); the verification/exercised-semantics lens about whether ONE static fixture genuinely fires; the double-entry ledger lens about whether ONE reconciliation BALANCES; the urushi lacquer lens about whether a box BONDS to the pixels in one frame; the isnad lens about whether a report's CHAIN OF TRANSMISSION reaches an eyewitness (provenance/attestation of a claim); the contracts scope-honesty lens about whether STATIC TEXT truthfully describes the code; the transhumance lens about whether coverage HOLDS ACROSS THE TIME AXIS of a moving sequence. NONE of them asks the mirab's question: at the DIVISION STRUCTURE where detections are sorted into cls-channels and routed to sinks, is EVERY face-carrying unit actually apportioned into an ACCOUNTED redaction share, or does the new mk-tne off-take (the vision_face branch) run DRY in the field even though the demonstration weir shows it flowing? This is the gap the diff makes concrete and that no covered lens is aimed at: cascade.py step 2b reads the independent face detector from `detectors.get("vision_face")` — an OFF-TAKE that only carries water if a "vision_face" detector was routed INTO the division dict. The §8.5 RELEASE GATE (scripts/check_redaction_recall.py:81-92) builds its OWN detectors dict and DOES cut that off-take (line 90 wires "vision_face" -> face_yolov8n). But PRODUCTION's real division-box, redact.py::_resolve_detectors (line 562), wires ONLY "person", "face", "plate" — it never cuts a "vision_face" off-take at all. So in the field, `detectors.get("vision_face")` returns None, step 2b is a silent no-op, and the entire person->face DECOUPLING the diff exists to provide DELIVERS ZERO WATER — while the head-gauge (the release gate, measuring at a test weir that HAS the off-take) reads 'all shares delivered' and goes green. That is a DRY ALLOTMENT and a PROXY HEAD-GAUGE at once: the promise ('a face is covered even when the person path finds nothing') is apportioned on the map, gauged at a demonstration structure, and carries no water at the real weir the village runs. The mirab — who has watched a household's field go dry under a ledger that balanced perfectly — walks the off-take sill to the field and refuses the head-gauge until water is seen leaving the structure into the promised share.

source_domain: Pre-modern, non-Western communal water-apportionment — the mirab / āb-yār / subak-pekaseh craft of DIVIDING one incoming irrigation stream into allotted shares at a physical PROPORTIONING STRUCTURE (a qanat taqsim-box, a stone division-weir, a notched Andean or Balinese partition sill). The mirab's sworn discipline is not measuring flow at one point but guaranteeing that the WHOLE incoming stream is APPORTIONED WITHOUT REMAINDER into the accounted share-channels: every drop that enters the head must leave through exactly ONE gauged off-take that belongs to a landholder's allotment, no drop escaping the division structure ungauged, no share-channel that appears on the ditch-map running DRY because its off-take sill was never actually cut into the weir, no two channels fed from a gauge that silently sends all the water down one and none down the other. The craft's native failure classes: the DRY ALLOTMENT (a share drawn on the map and promised to a household, but whose physical off-take carries zero water because the sill was never opened at the real weir — the map says 'irrigated', the field is parched); the UNGAUGED SPILL / BYPASS (water that escapes AROUND the division structure — over a low bund, through a scour-channel, past the last notch — so it is delivered to NO share and counted in NONE, lost from the apportionment entirely); the MIS-ROUTED SHARE (flow that physically arrives but is credited to the wrong channel — poured into an off-take that no downstream gate actually reads, so it irrigates nothing that the ledger tracks); the PROXY HEAD-GAUGE (a measurement taken at a TEST division-box — a demonstration weir with every off-take cut — asserted as proof about the FIELD's actual weir, which has fewer off-takes; the gauge reads 'all shares delivered' at a structure that is not the one the village runs); and the SELF-CLOSING TALLY (a division ledger that balances because the apportionment total is computed from the same map that omits the dry channel, so the omission is invisible to the reconciliation). The mirab distrusts the head-gauge and walks each off-take sill to the field to confirm water actually leaves the structure into every promised share.
